description: #195: the merge runner reads a PLAN, and a plan it did not produce can carry a shape the profile loader would have refused. The planner rejects a non-array `integration_baseline` (`load_error` / exit 6, plan case 76), but nothing stops a hand-written plan — profile-contract.md §10.6 names that route and status/resume read plans this planner never wrote — so the runner's own reading has to fall to the fail-closed side rather than to the fallback. Here `integration_baseline` is the bare string `"cat cmate-verify-ok"`, which would be perfectly runnable if it were coerced, and `baseline` is green: an implementation that coerced, or that treated "not an array" as "not declared", would merge both PRs and report a green integration verification. It refuses before the first merge instead, and `source` still says `integration_baseline` — the declaration was read, it just has nothing runnable in it. Applied with `plan_patch`, because this is a state the planner cannot produce.

summary_absent: profile に `baseline` を宣言してから再実行する
